chapters.title: Chapter 681: This must be fake!
paragraphs: Qian Zihou stopped where he was, his face was blue and red.
The fairy formation on the opposite side made him feel very tricky, and he couldn't grasp it directly.
"Damn it!"
"You have a fairy formation, are there two more?"
Qian Zihou cursed secretly, before turning around and leaving.
But at this moment.
Su Lang's faint voice came: "Qian Zihou, don't waste your efforts, all my cities are protected by immortal formations."
"Ghosts believe!"
Qian Zihou turned to look at Su Lang in the barrier, sneered, and left immediately.
What is the existence of Xianzhen?
Most of them are super large arrays built on the right time and place, which is difficult to deploy.
It is even more difficult to arrange the fairy formation in the formation.
You must be an immortal-level formation refining master who has reached a very deep level in order to arrange the low-level immortal-level formation in the formation.
Therefore, Qian Zihou decided that Su Lang had no more immortal formations.
Of course, he was completely wrong.
Because Su Lang just harvested countless materials, one hundred, one thousand immortal formations can be refined.
Watching Qian Zihou's departure, Su Lang's mouth outlines a touch of playfulness.
The feeling of playing Wuxian like a mouse is really good!
At this time.
Another system reminder came.
Several of Qian Zihou's subordinates were killed, and their belongings were plundered by Su Lang.
Su Lang was in a good mood.
Immediately he moved his body and went to another city.
In the Yaolan City, those warriors could not help but feel regret when they watched Su Lang disappear.
As soon as Su Lang sat there, Wu Xian was scared away. This scene was really awesome.
They haven't seen enough yet!
The other side.
Qian Zihou left Yaolan City and soon arrived at another city.
But when this city appeared in his eyes, his expression suddenly changed.
Nothing else.
Just because this city is also shrouded in pink fairy array!
"hiss!"
Qian Zihou took a hard breath, his teeth were cold.
"Two fairy formations...two fairy formations?!"
"Could it be that Su Lang moved the formation here!"
"No, it's not right, I'm all randomly selected cities, how does he know I'm coming here?"
"But if it wasn't for the transfer of the formation, then this immortal formation already existed?"
"What kind of identity is Su Lang? He really has a subordinate who can arrange an immortal formation!"
Qian Zihou trembled all over, then turned away again.
"There are two fairy formations in the small town of the sacred race, which is extremely incredible!"
"It takes countless materials and time to lay out the fairy formation. There will never be a third one, absolutely not!"
"The next city, I will definitely be able to break it!"
Qian Zihou left again.
He chose another city of the Yaochi tribe.
This time he fully expanded his mental perception to prevent being snooped.
But Qian Zihou didn't find anything suspicious at all.
There were only ordinary wild creatures on the ground, fleeing in groups, and he could kill them all with a single thought.
But killing these wild creatures has an ass.
Qian Zihou maintained his mental perception and arrived at the third city.
Then he stopped stiffly.
The third city is also guarded inside by a pink mask.
"This, this, this is the fairy formation again!?"
"This is impossible, this is impossible, this must be fake!"
Qian Zihou's face was distorted, his teeth were gritted, his eyes almost burst.
He violently unfolded his mental power and completely enveloped the formation.
He wants to break this ‘illusion’!
However, this is originally a real formation, what is an illusion?
Qian Zihou discovered this fact after doing a lot of useless work.
This made him very crushed.
Immortal formation!
In general, there is only one fairy clan.
But this little Yaochi saint clan, in addition to fairy tools, unexpectedly has three fairy-level formations!
This is too exaggerated!
"No, it must be my bad luck that I will encounter three cities with immortal formations."

Qian Zihou's heart suddenly burst, and his pupils couldn't help shrinking like needles.

"Let me be a dog and a pig?"

"The Lord has refined another fairy artifact!"

As he said, he looked at Murong Xianxian and Chu Xiaobei.
"Then give it to Xianxian."
Chu Xiaobei nodded generously, "Xianxian needs more than me."
"it is good!"
Su Lang smiled.
He originally thought that Chu Xiaobei would be willful once, but he did not expect that she would directly give this opportunity to Murong Xianxian.
This is great.
"Thank you sister!"
Murong Xianxian thanked him very gratefully.
Immediately, Su Lang also gave Murong Xianxian a cultivation base initiation, and he also raised his cultivation level to the Wuhuang level.
Then Murong Xianxian closed his eyes and was familiar with the skyrocketing power.
"Just let them retreat here."
Chu Xiaobei smiled, "No one dares to come here to disturb them anyway."
"Ok."
"It just happens that I want to ask you something."
Su Lang nodded and placed a formation between his hands to protect Ruxue and Slim.
"what's up?"
Chu Xiaobei asked strangely.
"Say while walking."
Su Lang patted Chu Xiaobei on the shoulder and walked in a random direction.
Chu Xiaobei glanced at her shoulder, then followed Su Lang behind him.
The two wandered around in the fairy palace.
"Go ahead, what do you want to ask?"
Chu Xiaobei walked beside Su Lang, the two were very close.
"I want to ask, do you miss home."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Well, it's the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, are you planning to go back?"
"Are you trying to push me away?"
Chu Xiaobei trembled, "I can't go back to the Xuanyu Fairy Clan!"
"no no!"
"Don't be so excited."
Su Lang was a little stunned.
He didn't expect Chu Xiaobei's reaction to be so big.
"Humph!"
"Do you know why I was hunted alone?"
Chu Xiaobei asked and replied, "Because I escaped from the Xuanyu Fairy Clan!"
"what?"
"Escape from the Xuanyu Fairy Clan!
Isn't that your clan?"
Su Lang asked in surprise, "Moreover, you have an unparalleled qualification, no one in a trillion, you should be the treasure of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan!"
Chu Xiaobei's eyes were blank, as if lost in memory, "The reason why I escaped from the Xuanyu Immortal Clan is because of my extraordinary aptitude."
"Tell me more carefully?"
Su Lang raised his brows and said.
"Unparalleled qualifications."
"Almost the highest level of cultivation qualification currently known."
"Who doesn't want to have an unparalleled qualification?
Everyone wants to have it!"
Chu Xiaobei smiled bitterly, "And I have the unparalleled qualifications, to some extent, it is a crime."

chapters.title: Chapter 699: Unparalleled, the posture of becoming an emperor!
paragraphs: "Have a crime?"
Su Lang frowned slightly, "How is it possible, aren't you born into a fairy clan?"
"What about the fairy?"
Chu Xiaobei shook his head and said, "Although I was born in the fairy clan, do you know how big the fairy clan is? How many factions are there?"
After a pause, before Su Lang could speak, Chu Xiaobei continued:
"The line I was born into is the weakest line in the fairy clan, and my father's generation made a big mistake, which is almost irreparable."
"Our line has the smallest number and the lowest status, and is looked down upon by the entire Xuanyu Immortal Clan."
"My birth has filled our veins with hope. All the elders have used cultivation resources on me."
"In addition, the elders were afraid that I would die halfway, so I concealed the fact of my unparalleled qualifications and told me not to leave a safe place."
Su Lang sighed: "You need to be so careful. It seems that you are indeed guilty of crimes."
In the world, the human heart is the most terrifying.
Chu Xiaobei stretched out his hands helplessly: "In this way, I can cultivate to the level of the Great Sage, and have the mysterious ice magic sky silk."
"But my cultivation speed is still too fast. With our resources, it is simply not enough to support me with such a fast cultivation speed."
"So, my aptitude was guessed and confirmed."
"And then!?" Su Lang asked.
"I was quite happy at first.
Chu Xiaobei said, "I thought I would be valued by the clan and gave me more resources, but I never expected that what was waiting for me was a huge trap."
"The person laying the trap is the patriarch of Xuanyuxian clan, Xuanyue Wuxian!"
"But I know that he is not behind the scenes. It is a stronger force that really wants to take my qualifications."
"If my guess is correct, it should be the emperor, and it is also the emperor of our Xuanyuxian clan, the Luoyou emperor!"
"Luoyou Emperor Clan!?"
"Emperor clan is hitting your attention!"
Su Lang took a breath, "Hi, I'm really curious about how you escaped!"
"The reason why I know that Wuxian Xuanyue is not behind the scenes is because, I can escape, he let me go."
"Xuanyue Wuxian was persecuted, and the other Wuxians in the clan were warned not to interfere in this matter."
"And the one who can intimidate an immortal clan is probably only the emperor clan."
Chu Xiaobei said, "And I am afraid that only the emperor has the heaven-defying means to seize the transfer cultivation qualifications."
"That's it."
Su Lang smiled slightly, "It seems that your Xuanyu patriarch still has some conscience."
"On the one hand, there is the of blood.
"On the other hand, it's probably because of the extraordinary aptitude has another name, that is, the posture of becoming an emperor!"
"It is almost impossible for the fairy clan to become an emperor, and I am the only hope for the Xuanyu Xian clan to become an emperor."
Chu Xiaobei said, "Xuanyue Wuxian couldn't bear me, the only emperor of the Xuanyuxian clan for tens of millions of years, to make wedding dresses for others, so I chose to let me go."
"Xuan Yue Wuxian let you go."
Su Lang said: "Then he, and the entire Profound Jade Immortal Clan, I'm afraid they will have to bear pressure from the emperor."
"Of course there is pressure."
"But the Emperor Luoyou will not make a direct shot."
"The seizure of qualifications is a crooked way, and this matter cannot be made public."
"And our Xuanyu Fairy Clan is also a subordinate force of Luoyou Emperor Clan in name."
"Therefore, the Luoyou Emperor Clan will not directly take action. The black hand behind the scenes will use other means to force us Xuanyu Immortal Clan to submit."
"This is also the reason Xuan Yue Wuxian dared to gamble-Xuan Yuxian clan will not directly face the disaster of extinction."
"As long as you carry it this time and save me, with my presence as an emperor, the emperor clan will not dare to go too far."
"Because no one knows whether I can really become an emperor in the future. If I really become an emperor, it will be a disaster for their Luoyou Emperor Clan."
Chu Xiaobei took a deep breath and said, "However, the premise is that they can't catch me, and my existence has been known by the Lu Tianlou.
I don't know if there is any contact between Lantianlou and Luoyou Emperor Clan, and will tell Luoyou Emperor Clan where I am.
To be honest, I am very worried and scared, Su Lang..."

chapters.title: Chapter 700: To become the empress!
paragraphs: "Is Luoyou Emperor Clan?"
"It sounds more terrifying than Slaughter Tower."

"However, as long as I am given a certain amount of time, the power of the emperor is nothing. After all, Emperor Wu is only a realm on the path of martial arts, and he is not an invincible existence in the world."
Su Lang smiled and looked at Chu Xiaobei, "You are alone now, and the Xuanyu Immortal Clan can't go back. Just stay by my side and I will protect you."
If an unsuspecting person saw this scene, their eyes would fall out.
A junior martial dared to speak up, saying that the power of the emperor was nothing, and he wanted to protect a martial sage with quasi-immortal combat power!
But in the eyes of Chu Xiaobei.
Su Lang really has this ability.
His potential is really terrifying, and his growth rate is even more terrifying.
It is precisely because of this that Chu Xiaobei gradually became dependent on Su Lang.
"Originally, I was entangled whether or not to leave everyone."
"But you said you want to protect me, then I won't leave, hehe!"
Chu Xiaobei laughed, her beautiful eyes like two beautiful meniscus.
"Hmm, I still need you to bring Xiaohai."
Su Lang smiled and nodded, "By the way, you should be able to use the fairy weapon now, give me your Frozen Cloud Fantasy Sky Ling, and I will help you promote to the fairy weapon.
In addition, the immortal soul pill I gave you was taken earlier, and strive to break through to the realm of Wuxian as soon as possible. "
Now that he knows there are enemies suspected of imperial clan.
Of course, Su Lang would not take it lightly, planning to use all the existing resources to improve combat power.
Chu Xiaobei was originally a quasi-celestial combat power.
Equip her with good weapons and let her break through to the realm of Wuxian as soon as possible.
This is very important for Su Lang's promotion.
Therefore, in addition to weapons and pill, he has another plan.
"Really, you are so kind to me."
Chu Xiaobei's eyes shone slightly, and immediately handed Bingyun Huantian Ling to Su Lang.
Bingyun Huan Tian Ling had just been promoted once, reaching the quasi-immortal level, and at this time it ushered in another promotion.
This time I encountered some trouble when I was promoted to Frozen Cloud Fantasy Sky Ling.
Some fairy-level materials are not in Su Lang's storage space.
After all, it is a fairy-level material, there is not much on the entire Canglan Continent.
So it is normal to lack one or two.
But this couldn't help Su Lang at all.
If there is no material, then synthesize it!
According to the required properties of the fairy-level materials, using holy-level materials with similar properties, there is a high chance of synthesizing them.
After spending a little time, Su Lang found out the missing materials, and also obtained some immortal-level materials that were temporarily useless.
After some operations.
Bingyun Huan Tian Ling was successfully evolved into a fairy weapon by Su Lang, giving birth to a device spirit.
This spirit is exactly the same as the spirits of Xiaohai Xiaopao and Xiangong, and it looks like a crystal bun.
Su Lang muttered in his heart, "Looking noisy, it doesn't have the fairy weapons that I have evolved, but the spirits are all like this, right?"
At this time.
Bingyun Huan Tian Ling's spirits actually flew up to Chu Xiaobei obediently, babbling in his mouth, but he could probably hear the words ‘Chu Xiaobei’.
"Su Lang, it knows my name!"
Chu Xiaobei was excited holding the spirit of Huan Tian Ling, with curiosity and affection on his face.
"Probably because it has been with you for a long time, that's why."
Su Lang smiled, "After all, when it was still a sacred weapon, although it did not have a spirit, it still has aura."
"Hmm, that should be it!"
Chu Xiaobei covered her mouth and giggled.
Su Lang had never seen her so happy and excited before, smiled, and said, "How do you feel about this Frozen Cloud Fantasy Sky Ling? Has it reached your control limit?"
"Well, it's almost there."
"Bing Yun Huan Tian Ling was promoted to an immortal weapon. I also need to consume a huge amount of spiritual energy to activate it."
Chu Xiaobei felt the power of Huan Tian Ling and hesitated.
"In that case, I will promote it next time."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised vigorously and smiled, "Come here today, you hurry up to practice, you have the qualifications to become an emperor, and you want to become a female emperor."
